name: docker-android
description: Runs Android emulators in Docker for app development and UI testing, with noVNC viewing, Appium support and a beta MCP server for agent control.

skills.name: Run Android Emulator
skills.description: Runs Android 9 to 14 emulators in Docker with device profiles and skins such as Samsung Galaxy S10 and Nexus 5.

skills.name: View in Browser
skills.description: Shows the running emulator in a browser through noVNC on port 6080, with container logs shareable from a web UI.

skills.name: Run UI Tests
skills.description: Runs unit and UI tests against the emulator with Appium, Espresso and other frameworks, including from Jenkins pipelines.

skills.name: Control via MCP
skills.description: Opens apps, visits URLs, presses buttons and reads the current window on the emulator through the beta HTTP MCP server.

skills.name: Remote adb Control
skills.description: Connects to the emulator from outside the container with adb connect to install, debug and drive apps from the host.

install.command: docker run -d -p 6080:6080 -e EMULATOR_DEVICE="Samsung Galaxy S10" -e WEB_VNC=true --device /dev/kvm --name android-container budtmo/docker-android:emulator_11.0
